scope: upstream, protocol, license, kernel, and XDNA1 feasibility research only

source_pins.whitepaper_revision: unversioned PDF; no explicit revision string found

license_review.hot_component_license_status: no clear component-level grant or SPDX declaration found for pearl-gemm, pearl-gateway, miner-base, py-pearl-mining, zk-pow, or pearl-blake3 in the inspected tree
license_review.implementation_policy: clean-room only until legal review resolves the exact component boundary

kernel.logical_representation: W7A7-like signed values in int8 containers; no packed-int7 instruction verified
kernel.main_gpu_multiply: signed int8 x signed int8 -> int32 accumulation
kernel.rank_domain: power of two 32..1024; r divisible by 16; current rank-penalty floor is 128
kernel.transcript_rotation: rotate-left 13 after XOR of each full-r chunk
kernel.quantization: symmetric, max_val=63 for quant_7bit, round-to-nearest, clamp, fp32 scale, no zero point
kernel.activation_or_fusion: none in the mining GEMM hot path

proof_dependencies.commitments: keyed BLAKE3 over padded A and B^T
proof_dependencies.noise_seeds: derived from job key and commitment hashes
proof_dependencies.candidate_check: little-endian U256 keyed BLAKE3 jackpot compared with derived target
proof_dependencies.opening: selected A rows and B^T columns with Merkle data
proof_dependencies.certificate: versioned PlainProof followed by CPU/Rust Plonky2/STARKy ZK generation
proof_dependencies.proof_generation_location: CPU/Rust gateway after a GPU-side hit

network.gateway_transport: line-delimited JSON-RPC over /tmp/pearlgw.sock or loopback TCP 8337
network.external_pool_protocol: unknown; no official Stratum implementation found

xdna1.target: AMD Ryzen AI Hawk Point, XDNA1, AIE2, four columns
xdna1.official_capability_basis: AIE2/XDNA documentation exposes int8 vector arithmetic and GEMM-oriented kernels
xdna1.reason: No Pearl kernel has been implemented or differentially verified; data movement, transcript hashing, proof overhead, and four-column scaling are unmeasured
xdna1.minimum_effective_batch: not established; P2 must measure from batch 1

first_order_model.representative_tile: M=128, N=256, r=128, one rank chunk
first_order_model.measurement_status: model only; no Pearl throughput or hashrate measured
